components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Still accepted as flat input for

            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with, when present, a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input and is
            normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to
            the composed 'address' after 'addressLine1' with a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized into
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9 ()+.]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand',
            computed as the owner's age on the registrationDate. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-

            another owner already has the same last name and address (i.e. they
            share a household). When absent or false, such a request is rejected
            with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - type: object
          properties:

              title: ID

              type: integer
              format: int32

              description: >-

              type: string

              description: >-

            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-

                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of
                owners at the time of creation.

              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the owner's fiscal year (see 'fiscalYear'),
                derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year that the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate falls in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to the next year's
                fiscal year (e.g. 2026-08-11 -> 'FY27', 2026-01-05 -> 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household, derived
                from the owner's last name and address. Owners with the same last
                name and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace) share the same value, so members created via the
                'sharesHousehold' flag receive the same household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1B4D6E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>'. All
                duplicate detection is consolidated into this single key: creating
                an owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its whole identity
                key equals an existing owner's. Because the telephone is part of the
                key, two members of the same household with different telephones have
                different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A9C1B4D6E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Fixed when the owner is created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-

                plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 for a tenure
                of more than one elapsed fiscal year (the number of fiscal years

                date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-

            locality:

              type: string

              type: boolean
              example: false

            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-

              type: boolean
              example: false

            possibleDuplicateOf:

              type: integer
              format: int32

              description: >-

              type: boolean
              example: false
